text:
On my son's face,
as he sleeps, come down
sands from the dunes,
sugarcane blossom,
and foam that flies
from the waterfall…

And all that falls on him
is only dream;
dream falls on his mouth,
dream on his back,
and they steal his body
along with his soul.

And so they cover him
with such cunning
that in the night I have
no son, nothing,
a mother blind with shadow,
a mother robbed.

Until blessed sun
at last bathes him:
it gives him back to me as a lovely
peeled fruit
and places him whole
upon my lap!

translation.title: To My Son’s Face...
